personalized_request_equivalence.meaning: Groups bind exact reconstructed prompt, system, caller settings, backend identity, configured timeout, item and order hashes. Repeated requests are repeated recorded executions; they are not new independent judgments or interchangeable stochastic outcomes. Every recorded attempt and job cost remains counted.
personalized_request_equivalence.scope: Personalized672 rows only. No extra raw inputs, semantic grouping, alias adoption, automatic reuse or historical mutation.

trace_path_derivation.rule: Anchor each explicitly referenced result.json at its job-ID parent; derive only numbered started/complete files for each result-pinned pair. Require raw SHA256 before parsing; no directory scan or alternate path search.

limits: Saved artifact consistency is not provider-origin authentication or actual wire capture; configured temperature0 is not sent by the adapter.
